text:
ops-bot: ALERT: Elevated latency & token backlog observed for model family 'pegasus-14b'. 95th p50 p99 spikes; auto-scaler not keeping up. Thresholds tripped. Paging oncall.

mike (oncall): On it. Pulling metrics. Can someone confirm if this is internal traffic spike or customer-driven?

sara (sre): Customer traffic spike — top 3 tenants show burst at 12:13 UTC. Seeing queue depth growth on gpu-pool-7. Latency > 1.2s p95 for generation endpoints.

mike (oncall): OK. Plan: immediate soft-reduction of TPM/RPM for pegasus-14b family, enable fallback to pegasus-14b-quant for non-critical tiers, and suspend function-calling for that family for now. @raj please coordinate support comms.

mike (oncall): Running mitigation: 
```
/admin quota update --model pegasus-14b --tpm 25 --rpm 50 --reason "live latency mitigation"
/admin feature-toggle set --model pegasus-14b --funcall disabled
``` 
Applying now.

sara (sre): I pushed the quota update, propagated to edge routing. New soft caps: TPM=25 RPM=50. Funcall_disable flag = true. Logs:
```
2026-03-17T12:15:32Z quota-service: updated model=pegasus-14b tpm=25 rpm=50 by mike
2026-03-17T12:15:33Z routing: route-change applied to all regions
```

elaine (support): Notifying top affected customers. Drafting message: "We've applied temporary rate controls for pegasus-14b to stabilize latency; we'll update within 30m." Sending to VIPs now.

raj (prodeng): I'll stand by for rollback thresholds. Suggest monitor window 10m; if p95 < 600ms and queue depth reduced by 50% we start a staged increase (+10 TPM every 5m). Agree?

sara (sre): Agree. Starting 10m monitor. Creating watch alert channel and adding logs:
- watch window start 12:16 UTC
- monitor rule: p95_gen_latency < 600ms AND queue_depth < 30

ops-bot: NOTE: paging metrics channel created: #incidents-1768002468

mike (oncall): Handing off after stabilization. @raj you are on secondary. @sara keep an eye for any failovers. Leaving note for postmortem: potential autoscaler backpressure + large prefix caching miss.

sara (sre): At 12:23 UTC p95 = 520ms, queue_depth down 62%. Proceed with ramp plan.

raj (prodeng): Increasing TPM -> 35 (ramp step 1). Command:
```
/admin quota update --model pegasus-14b --tpm 35
```

sara (sre): Applied. p95 momentary blip to 610ms, then back to 580ms. Continue ramp.

raj (prodeng): Next step TPM -> 45 in 5m if stable.

elaine (support): Customer updates: sent to 6 customers, CS ticket created for those requesting SLAs.

mike (oncall): Good. Marking incident as mitigated once queue stabilized for 15m. Leaving handoff: @raj primary, @sara secondary, @elaine customer comms. Add to postmortem backlog.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; monitoring. Incident state: partial mitigation. Incident ID: INC-1768002468

sara (sre): final note: Investigate autoscaler thresholds + cold KV cache effect on pegasus-14b. Will include traces in postmortem.

raj (prodeng): Acknowledged. I'll own postmortem write-up. Closing thread when incident moved to resolved.

mike (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup:
